description: This file contains implementation code for internal Abseil string handling, specifically for analyzing and managing Cord representations and their statistics, including classes like CordRepAnalyzer and CordzInfo.

classes.name: CordRepAnalyzer
classes.description: Performs analysis of CordRep structures to compute node counts and memory usage statistics.

classes.name: CordzInfo
classes.description: Holds metadata and manages lifecycle of Cord representations, including tracking, untracking, and statistics gathering.

methods.name: AnalyzeCordRep
methods.description: Analyzes a CordRep structure to update node counts and memory usage statistics.

methods.name: Head
methods.description: Returns the head of the global CordzInfo list for a given snapshot.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Returns the next CordzInfo in the list for a given snapshot.

methods.name: TrackCord
methods.description: Creates and tracks a new CordzInfo for a given InlineData cord.

methods.name: Untrack
methods.description: Removes a CordzInfo from tracking and deletes it if safe.

methods.name: GetCordzStatistics
methods.description: Returns statistics about the CordzInfo, including size and analysis.
